state.project: GTC: Garrett Rd - V. Rica 230kV Line Reconductor (CC Net Im)
state.description: GTC will reconductor the section from East Villa Rica Switching station to Garrett Rd with 160C 1351 ACSS on 11.5 miles of the Garrett Road - Villa Rica 230kV line. Additionally, the 2.5 miles section from East Villa Rica Switching Station to Villa Rica will be rebuilt with bundled 200C 1351 ACSS Martin.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
